description: Open Nuclear Engineering Teaching Suite, published by open-nuclear-suite, provides interactive desktop teaching simulators for reactor physics, core loading and thermal hydraulics. Coverage: The documented software is configured for the chosen system; the reviewed pages establish no fixed geographic coverage, spatial resolution or time horizon. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. The licence is MIT. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: The provider explicitly limits the suite to introductory teaching. Its simplified models are not suitable for reactor design, licensing, safety analysis, operator training or real plant operations. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning, resilience studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
